run_image_dataloading_benchmark: run the image dataloading benchmark across multiple GPUs using a file list of image paths
build_pipeline_get_pipeline: build an image data loading pipeline that decodes images concurrently and transfers batches to GPU
create_source_iterator: create an iterator that reads image paths from a file list and splits them across workers
decode_batch_decode: decode a batch of images from file paths, resize them, and send the tensor to a GPU device
benchmark_dataloader: benchmark an image dataloader iterator and measure frames per second and batches per second
